page.content:
1996 TNG film about the Borg and Cochrane's warp flight.

How Star Trek: First Contact connects

  • Topic: Star Trek — First Contact is the 1996 TNG feature film.
  • Character: Jean-Luc Picard — First Contact is Picard's Borg film.
  • Faction: Borg Collective — First Contact is a Borg assault on Earth's past.
  • Series: Star Trek: The Next Generation — First Contact continues the TNG crew on film.
  • Location: Earth — First Contact is fought over Earth's warp-flight past.
  • Technology: Warp drive — First Contact protects Cochrane's first warp flight.

What is Star Trek: First Contact?

First Contact sends the Enterprise-E after a Borg sphere into Earth's past, where Picard faces Locutus's trauma and humanity's first warp flight is protected.

Key threads lead to Star Trek, Jean-Luc Picard, Borg Collective, Star Trek: The Next Generation, Earth and Warp drive.
